notes.title: NEW MULTIPLAYER GAME MODE + perfecting slopes!
notes.content:
Dear DASHers. Today a new build is live. While there is only a few bug fixes and a nice new 'reversed' slope (basically an upside down slope to give new shapes to structures in levels) we are also introducing the first multiplayer mode in the DASHgame. But behold... you must be patient because there is still some way to go until the mode is all the way in the box!

[b]Build 2007; Early Access; Steam:[/b]

- The currency and shop is still not available so players will not receive any gifts or medals yet.
- [i]The mode in BUILD 2007 is strictly for testing server and game compatibility![/i] As mentioned there is no reward or visible log screen where you can overview contestants, rewards and all-over score.
- [i]You can't yet see your opponents.[/i] [b][i]YET!![/i][/b] Our next priority (as soon as we can see that the server-to-game system is polished and properly look at by the DASHers and devs) is to include other players in your game screen on the levels. So you will see other players simultaneously on your screen.
- There are so many cool things we can do with this new mode!. Besides from fixing and bug-hunting we would love some intuitive responses from DASHers like "[i]which things we would like to see and experience during this mode[/i]".
- Have you tried the Gameboy shader called "4 Colors" yet?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/66147bcf1abea6e183e2a9b317d635bcdd6390a4.gif[/img]

notes.title: First Patch Up: Major enhancements and fixes to the release build!
notes.content:
This first patch to the Early Access build includes most important fixes which are major to the overall shape of the game. The collision and tile-placement error(s) are postponed for next patch:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/64d0b6ddfa3b916a6a208a1d498511daff0edba1.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed crash caused by overstacking memory due to not deleting sprite being stored in memory. The game would crash after the Pause Menu (opened to Respawn) being opened hundreds of time, stacking up memory each time without clearing it.
[*] You can now Respawn with one push on the controller: hit the back/share button (the little button left to the logo on the controller) to instantly respawn!
[*] Prevented cheat: before this patch player could load level, change the tiles, set a record and leave without saving making it possible to basically upload a level which is unbeatable. This bug was carefully figured out by @Doctor2B - Here’s a challenge for you: if you can upload another unbeatable level (like the Box) we will keep it in the pool. If not.. it will be binned :gg: The challenge is on!!
[*] A new record on a level is now seen as a modification to that l level. So in order to keep any newly set records during a session you must now remember to Save Level before exiting in order to keep level up to date.
[*] The editor now only prompts you for Save option if there is any changes made. If not it closes without asking.
[*] Now shows “Record Reset” consistently every time you edit a level after a record is set
[*] Juiced up Main Menu: A little jelly effect as you toggle the options + new backgrounds
[*] EASTER EGGS for the DASH International: go find them yourself, I won’t spoil ‘em
[*] During some testing the level called “GGRC_Sample” by Arrrcee was deleted because of certain circumstances. Please reupload it if you are the creator!
[*] Toggle sound effect in Pause Menu now corrected to be exact (Thanks @crazed )
[*] Another careful observation by @doctor2b showed us that Duffie and Max Leap are equally fast on flat ground. Duffie is now set to be a little faster and Max Leap a little slower in runSpeed. It was a neat tweak and only defines their character even more.
[*] Change Hero in Pause Menu now called Hero Select
[*] Fixed crash caused by missing sprite index in the world record ghost object
[*] 
[/list]

LIVE FEED OF RECORDS AND LEVELS ON OUR DISCORD SERVER! [url=discord.gg/3JPpNey ]JOIN HERE![/url]

GG!

- Jake

notes.title: Game Makeover! New Update Introduces Several New Parts of the Game! (build 251)
notes.content:
Alpha build 251 is live. Let the client update the program and launch!
The new splash screen will tell you a bit about the new DASH World.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/4e7a7e485f1068a52091e625d44ff222d8798539.jpg[/img]

[b]Introducing Worlds:[/b]
- When launching the new update you automatically are signed into DASH World (http://dashworld.babyduka.com)
- In DASH World you can create lists of levels - called *Worlds*
- A world consists of multiple levels in a series
- You can edit the lists on the site and finally see them in the game as you enter the Play menu (also referred to as Run menu)
- If you are not logged in through the game you will not be able to see our edit your lists
- Once you launch the game it only needs to log you in once as long as you keep your cookie in your browser. If you lose the cookie it will generate one automatically again, so everything should be smooth and painless
- A set of default Worlds is automatically in the game. These can be deleted, edited or updated in DASH World too
- In the Run Menu you will have an option to view custom Worlds or the default filters set by us

[b]New Menu and UI Design:[/b]
- New Splash Screen design
- New Main Menu design
- New Hero Menu design - removed the Story tab
- New Menu and Level Name font
- Updated main title graphics in Main Menu and Run Menu
- New *action* text font (as you complete levels this text will appear)

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
- The overall gravity for the game is now lowered by 0.1 - meaning that the Hero's fall speed is a little slower
- The creator now is the one to suggest a Special power up. Before it was the player who set his/her Special in the Story tab (which is now removed). You turn on a special power by snatching an Elemental stone.
- New Elemental Stone system instead of previous Special system: you can max carry 2 stones - for now we have the Blue stone (air) and the Red stone (fire) - you can either have 1 blue and 1 red, or 2 red, or 2 blue. Each blue stone gives you an extra dash and each red stone adds to your dash of fire (creating a wider ranger of fire). One red and one blue is double dash with dash of fire!
- New graphics to show the special power is on and to make more of the power's awesomeness

[b]Upgrades & Fixes:[/b]
- Removed the "P" as the pause button and made Esc the global pause button. More intuitive and needs no legend to explain
- Fixed error in animation when dashing down. Before it would be off to either side with several pixels when dashing downward, making it look like the 'dash cloud' was next to the Hero instead of right behind the Hero
- Duffie has a new rubbery jump sound (after all he is half man half rubber duck)
- Hero's ammo now displayed relative to unique weapon during runs

[b]Resetting user (locally):[/b]
- In order to test some new implementations and to get feedback on starting the game in this new state, we will reset all accounts so that local medals will be 0 and your level folder will be set as a new one. You still have the levels in the previous build folder and online if you uploaded it
- You still keep your world records online

[b]New audio:[/b]
- New theme in Run Menu ("Get Ready For Runnin' by Baby Duka")
- New button SFXs in Run Menu
- New Special SFXs

[b]Notes:[/b]
- Some levels might be strange to play with the new Special Power feature (triple dash)
- Gamepads still don't function 100% on Linux
- Large levels with over 300 tiles can take several minutes to compress and save on a medium computer
- Erasing the goal tile will in some cases remove an unwanted tile instead
- Walking enemies can strand licking the wall

notes.title: The Danger Action Speed Heroes have arrived!
notes.content:
Hello all level creators, speedrunners, platformer fans and all DASHers in general. Welcome! My name is Jake and I'm the solo-dev bringing this baby to life. I've been a developer for some years and this is my first major project.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/4e7a7e485f1068a52091e625d44ff222d8798539.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/f9512a2dedd44420321783f36a7533f4bf1f0428.gif[/img]

DASH is designed to make you creative! To make you want more from the game and games in general. In DASH the world is open for you to design and create. The Early Access launch later this year will bring you a solid engine, a large catalogue of Heroes, blocksets and tools and hopefully a very very cool community too! This game will be nothing (and I repeat NOTHING) without you, so if you feel like jumping on this train, I suggest you do so. Go wishlist the game to make sure to get notified once the Early Access launch is live!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/74fe6cc95a589f1fc0a8a17bc5fbc016c8e83e07.gif[/img]

Since September 2017 I have been on a mission to create the ultimate pixelart 2D action/precision platformer creation tool (in short: a 2D action/precision platformer where you create your own levels and share them with the world!) I have come a long way and if you wish to really dig deep into the dev of DASH check out the [url= https://www.indiedb.com/games/d-a-s-h-danger-action-speed-heroes]devlog on the IndieDB! [/url] The game is fully compatible with the workshop and you will be able to download and upload user generated content. In fact... that's whta DASH is all about.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/bc8dcb9fe417c619d5904f0c2bfb538e8fbb918e.png[/img]

DASH alpha is currently being tested by the Test Team. If you wish to come along this very early journey please visit the DASH [url=https://discord.gg/beWeez9] Discord![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/04cf418d8160575748f31a3ccc0b997283456efb.png[/img]

Every Saturday Jake sums up the updates and fixes from the past week and shows off some gameplay. At 8pm GMT | 12pm GMT on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/BabyDuka] Baby Duka's Twitch Channel![/url] More streams will be coming as the dev intensifies so go follow to get notified!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/5edb5099b8fefdc9ff8dfba98ddf1a2e7ffda151.gif[/img]

The best way as an interested gamer to keep track of the dev is to join the Discord or visit the [url=http://www.babyduka.com/dashgame] official website [/url].

I'm very very glad you're here! Please know that.
